text_block_list.text: (Chatter, chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
What's with that crowd over there...
Approaching the crowd, I saw several reporters with cameras and voice recorders interviewing the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is... Oh?
Were we standing in your way?
If so, I am terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
We are currently conducting interviews with the
Umamusume active in this year's Classic series—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Classic Year... That means this interview is for Kris S and the others... right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
My, how adorable! Could you be
an Umamusume who hasn't debuted yet?
To think there was such a lovely girl here...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-umm...
choice_data_list: Yes, my name is Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You're Zenno Rob Roy, right!
If you don't mind, could you share your thoughts and enthusiasm for your upcoming debut?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh...
T-Trainer...!
choice_data_list: If Rob Roy is fine with it, I don't mind

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Now then, Zenno Rob Roy-san...
What kind of Umamusume do you want to become?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Ah, um... well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course!!
Hero...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Eng...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, I was just thinking...
I'd like to be able to speak English..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. English, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.
Several more questions followed after that, but... Zenno Rob Roy's interview came to an end without her being able to give clear answers.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's... um... I'm sorry.
I—I tried to answer... but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm... still as plain and unnoticeable as ever...
I don't have any eye-catching talent or memorable charm at all—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: For someone like me to say I want to become a hero... If I went around proclaiming that, I'd just become a laughingstock...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Once I realized that... my voice... just wouldn't come out...
Zenno Rob Roy was completely feeling down. As I comforted her while gazing at the training course—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's Kris S-san.

The one being interviewed is Symboli Kris S.
She's a powerhouse senior Umamusume who has achieved proven results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, you have no concerns about the rotation from the Aoba Sho to the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will do what must be done.
—That remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see, even a rotation that no one has ever used to conquer the Derby—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"And even the Japanese Derby itself,
the dream of every Umamusume,
is nothing more to her than a task that must be done..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...It's completely different.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, um...
I was just thinking how completely different Kris S-san and I are.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course Kris S-san is an upperclassman, and
she's far stronger than me as an Umamusume,
to the point where even comparing us is disrespectful, but still!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it's not about being a different age, or being strong, or anything like that... It's something much more fundamental—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What does it take
to carry oneself with such confidence...?
That's what I wondered.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The heroes I know never choked on their words
or hung their heads in shame
like I do."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I was looking toward the future I must take, gazing ahead.
...Just like Kris S. Simply looking forward.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...What can I do to be like that—
choice_data_list: First, how about trying to get to know them?
First, why don't you try getting to know them?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To know...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're right. How Kris S
can manage to be like that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I want to know. More.
To the very depths of my idol's heart.
From that day on—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
K-Kris S-san! Tomorrow morning...
would it be okay if I joined you for your run...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...?
—No problem.
—Zenno Rob Roy began tagging along for Symboli Kris S's training.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*――No good.
At this rate... she's just gonna pull further and further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I know it. I don't have anywhere near enough stamina...
To begin with, our physical builds are just completely different.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Because... I want to know...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Kris S-san...
Why do you run so much
every single day?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, of course I understand that this is
training for the Derby, but still!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even on rainy days...
Even on days scheduled for heavy training,
this lady never stops her running practice.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (It shouldn't hurt to take a little break... or change up the schedule just a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Management.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Supervision...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
From the Aoba Sho to the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby),
we have one month to make adjustments—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Thorough management.
Changes... will not be permitted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What about the days when you're just not feeling it,
or when you wish you could take it a bit easier...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't there at least one day
where you're so exhausted
you don't want to move a single inch...?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"None.
—I have resolved to accomplish it."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Once again, she is...
looking straight ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Then I... I will too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I... at least let me do the distance running with you!
I promise I'll keep up every single day...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (On some days, Kris S-san gets out of the pool after just 20 minutes. She says it's because that's what's optimal for the day.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Heading down to the pool, changing into my swimsuit.
Just that takes 25 minutes.
25 minutes of prep for 20 minutes in the water.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Umamusume love to run.
They sometimes get bored with training that only consists
of bench presses and exercise bikes.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (When Kris S-san decides on it, she finishes her whole day with just machine workouts.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer was surprised.
Maintaining motivation is part of a Trainer's job, but she needs none of that.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Whenever I asked her how she could be like that, whether training wasn't painful, she would always give the same answer.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Because that
is what must be done—right now.”

And after some more time had passed—
Symboli Kris S steadily continued her
preparations for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...You're incredible, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rob Roy-san...
You were watching her too, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, she is incredible.
There are several reasons why winning the Japanese Derby right after the Aoba Sho is considered difficult, but—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
One of them is said to be
"the sheer difficulty of conditioning and management."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"...In just one month, I have to recover from fatigue
and reach peak condition for the crucial moment
that is the Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet that girl never changes.
It's rare to see an Umamusume who stays
so completely unfazed."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Ahead of my gaze, Kris S-san—whether on a whim or by chance, suddenly looked at me.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Under those clear, piercing eyes, I felt as if
she were asking, "What about you?"—
and I looked away.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...You stand so effortlessly,
completely unshaken.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Acting like it's nothing... There's no way that's true.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I never imagined... that Kris S-san was running for this long every single day...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Never skipping training even when it's a hassle, keeping it up even when it's boring... I never knew any of that.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I used to think that people who are strong and cool
were just strong and cool right from the start—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —I'm so stupid.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*...!
Nnnngh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I made it... to the goal...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san... I...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —For the first time... I've made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Um... you see...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I only did...!
...what had to be done, that is all...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —What should we do about the return trip?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, that's right, we still have to get back home...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Leaving my panicked self aside, Kris S-san was, as always, staring straight ahead.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (That gaze resembles a sword.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (A beautiful sword drawn by a hero, gleaming brightly in the morning sun. That's how it looked to me.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (That's why I, too—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I found myself wanting that sword as well.)
